title: terrain/cellstate.json, terrain/cellstate_conservative.json
description: Placement and legend of terrain/cellstate.png, the routing-grid cell states (F1: assessed / blocked / unknown) for hatching unknown terrain. PNG encoding as the field PNGs: 8-bit RGBA, counts = R*256 + G (0 assessed, 1 blocked), B = 0, A = 255 known, A = 0 unknown (state 2, incl. non-HiRISE and no data). One PNG pixel per routing cell, rows north to south. Written by make web from WS1's cellstate_3m.tif (tools/make_web.py). Added in v1.1.0. v1.1.2: the same schema for terrain/cellstate_conservative.json (+ .png), from WS1's cellstate_3m_conservative.tif (variant conservative: blocked = max 1 m slope > 20 - V1 RMSE deg); manifest keys terrain.cellstate_conservative.pct.*. Since D22/D23 (2026-11-14 16:16, 16:20): blocked = 3 m plane-fit slope above the variant's no-go (25 / 20 / 17°) or the 30° step guard; descriptive change only, the encoding is unchanged.
x-source: SPEC §2.2 F1 (unknown drawn hatched); brief WS1 (cellstate_3m.tif); WS5 STATUS (no cell-state web file)

image.description: PNG path relative to the data root (terrain/cellstate.png or terrain/cellstate_conservative.png)

bounds.description: [w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg of the outer pixel edges

codes.description: state code -> label (0 assessed, 1 blocked, 2 unknown)

pct.description: share of the image's cells in each state, %
